To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the vibration of wind tunnel model can cause large scale separated vortex shedding before stall incidence and the occurrence of stall is earlier than the steady meaning incidence.
the unsteady separated vortex sheddings induced by vibration can cause large scale vortex shedding and stall occurring at some lower incidences than the steady meaning one.
the unsteady separated vortex is caused by the vibration and the unsteady separated vortices will cause the stall to occur at lower incidence.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the unsteady aerodynamic of an airfoil in the wind-tunnel with the model vibrating,which is of great significance for the wind-tunnels with large scale airplane models.
the effects of wind-tunnel vibration on aerodynamic performance of the wind-tunnel model and the influence of different phase delay on the aerodynamic performance of an airfoil.
the effects of the vibration of airfoil in wind tunnels on the flow field and aerodynamics of the airfoil.

the vibration of airfoil can change the aerodynamic characteristics of airfoil and the effect of the vibration on the aerodynamics of airfoil is related to the vibration mode and the phase delay.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is very important to study the effects of wind-tunnel model vibration on the flow field and aerodynamics of airfoil at high incidence.
the vibration of airfoil can lead to the occurrence of flow-field separation and aerodynamic stall at lower incidence than the still case,which may be a new mechanism for stall.
the vibration of wind tunnel models can cause the stall incidence to occur at lower angle of attack than the still model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the vibration of wind tunnel models may cause the stall of the model at some lower incidence.
the vibration of windtunnel model may cause the occurrence of stall before the steady stall incidence.
the vibration of wind tunnel models should be taken into account when the aerodynamic characteristics of the airfoil at high incidence are investigated.
